dedupe_keys.name: times the integrated markal efom system iea etsap energy system optimisation model generator

description: TIMES is the bottom-up linear optimisation model generator developed by the Energy Technology Systems Analysis Programme, a Technology Collaboration Programme of the International Energy Agency, as the successor of MARKAL. The ETSAP pages, read on 2026-09-26, describe it as producing least-cost pathways that meet projected energy service demands under constraints, choosing technology investments, operation, primary supply and trade across regions, periods and sectors. Models are built around a Reference Energy System of technologies, commodities and flows, with user-defined periods and sub-annual time slices, vintages, multi-region trade and a partial equilibrium with price-elastic demand; users in more than 50 countries apply it at scales from local to global. The generator is written in GAMS and available free under the GNU GPL version 3 from GitHub, but running it needs a commercial GAMS licence with a solver, and most users also buy the VEDA interface, so the total cost is not zero. ETSAP lists open-source model instances, including the ETSAP-TIAM global model, starter models, training courses and a forum. Caveats: results depend on each model's database. Simulation uses are long-term capacity planning and optimisation of energy systems. Related records: model-times-ireland-model is a national TIMES model.
